description: Local UI Server Function input: the values of the form that makes a write scenario from one candidate of the latest discovery (Task 28 design 4.6). The candidate is named by its identity digest. T38f (Task 38 design 3.7): an API candidate row is selected by the shape digest of its probe as well (shapeDigest; omitted for a FORM candidate).

ledgerScenarioId.description: FM2b (the fewer manual steps design 3A.2): the ledger (a create scenario) chosen beforehand for an API UPDATE row from the guide of the automatic drafts. Only a suggestion: the server ignores it unless it is one of the ledger options (so the form of the id is checked by the options, not copied to the screen; FM2R Minor 13), and the store checks the saved draft as usual.

formPathTemplate.description: FM2b: the update page template chosen beforehand (a suggestion; ignored unless it is one of the template options).
